top_stories.title: AI disruption in Indian IT front-loaded, but long-term demand intact: Sushovan Nayak - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Indian IT companies** are experiencing revenue deflation due to AI-related disruption, but the market may be undervaluing opportunities in legacy modernization and sovereign AI projects. **Infosys**, **LTIMindtree**, and **Tech Mahindra** are among the largecap firms expected to benefit from this shift as they act as implementation partners for enterprise AI platforms. The industry is also moving towards outcome-based contracts, driving changes in workforce structures with a focus on client-facing mid and senior-level professionals. While acknowledging near-term volatility, the analyst believes the sector's long-term growth trajectory remains intact driven by AI-led transformation and expanding enterprise demand.

top_stories.title: Silver, gold open flat as investors assess Iran war peace deal uncertainty. Where are precious metals headed? - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **MCX silver futures** for July 2026 delivery rose Rs 167 to Rs 2,66,350 per kg on the domestic market, while **gold futures** for June 2026 delivery gained Rs 258 at Rs 1,59,499 per 10 grams. Market participants are awaiting U.S. economic data, including nonfarm payrolls and employment reports, for clues about the strength of the labor market as inflationary pressures linked to the Middle East conflict persist. Spot gold remained steady at $4,481.53 per ounce, while **U.S. gold futures** edged up 0.1% to $4,511.20 per ounce.

top_stories.title: Coforge shares gain over 2% after unveiling agentic AI platform for insurance industry - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Coforge**, a technology company, has launched the **Nexa Agentic AI Platform**. This platform utilizes its own **Coforge One AI platform** to offer insurers a marketplace of over 30 insurance AI assets. These capabilities include automated data extraction and prioritization for underwriting, faster rate, form, and filing automation, accelerated product launches, and improved claims triaging. The platform is designed to help insurers scale AI adoption without replacing core systems and is intended for use across various insurance segments including Property & Casualty, Life & Annuities, Specialty Insurance, MGAs, and intermediaries.  The company plans to progressively integrate insurance knowledge graphs into the platform to enhance reasoning capabilities.

top_stories.title: Wockhardt shares pause massive 36% rally in 5 sessions; slip 7%. What’s behind the selloff? - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Wockhardt** announced the FDA approval of its novel antibiotic, ZAYNICH, for treating complicated urinary tract infections. The drug combines cefepime and zidebactam to target multiple penicillin-binding proteins, addressing a critical healthcare challenge of antimicrobial resistance.  The company reported strong financial performance in Q4FY26, with net profit up significantly year-over-year and revenue growth driven by biotech operations and international expansion. **Wockhardt** shares have experienced substantial gains in recent years, reflecting investor confidence in the company's growth prospects.

top_stories.title: IT rally rages on! Infosys, TCS, other stocks jump up to 4% despite overall market weakness - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Nifty IT** index surged for a third consecutive day, reaching 30,785 on Tuesday.  This rally was driven by investor optimism about the sector's resilience in the face of AI advancements. **Infosys**, **TCS**, and other major IT companies saw significant gains, with analysts citing their strong cash flow and adaptability to evolving technologies. The surge comes ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy meeting under Chair Kevin Warsh, who was appointed by President Donald Trump.

top_stories.title: NEET UG Retest June 21 in pen and paper mode: NTA briefs parliament panel amid fresh political storm
top_stories.rephrased_article: A parliamentary committee meeting examining pen-and-paper versus computer-based testing systems devolved into a political debate over the June 21 NEET-UG retest. **Digvijaya Singh**, chair of the committee, expressed concern about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's personal accountability for preventing another paper leak.  **NTA officials** defended their plan to conduct the re-examination in pen-and-paper format and assured the panel that adequate safeguards were in place. The committee also prevented representatives from a doctors’ body, **United Doctors Front**, from presenting their concerns regarding the NEET-UG examination process.

top_stories.title: US to Deport 30 Indian Nationals Caught Working Illegally as Truck Drivers
top_stories.rephrased_article: **US Border Patrol agents** conducted an operation called "Operation Checkmate" in the Yuma Sector of Arizona, detaining 52 undocumented individuals, including 30 Indian nationals who were operating commercial trucks.  The individuals had employment authorization documents issued under the previous administration that have since expired. **Acting Chief Patrol Agent Dustin Caudle** stated that the operation aims to enforce immigration laws and prevent accidents involving unqualified drivers. All detainees will be processed under federal law and deported.

top_stories.title: Anant Raj shares rally 5% after signing Rs 25,000 crore Haryana Data Centre MoU - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Anant Raj**, a real estate and infrastructure developer, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the **Haryana Enterprises Promotion Centre (HEPC)** to invest approximately Rs 25,000 crore in building data centers and cloud infrastructure across Haryana. The agreement was formalized during the "Make in Haryana Policy & Other Sectoral Policies" event on June 1, 2026, and involves several key government departments and agencies. **Anant Raj** aims to expand its Digital Infrastructure Business, which encompasses both data center operations and cloud services.  The partnership is designed to support the company's expansion and position Haryana as a major hub for next-generation digital infrastructure investments.

top_stories.title: Nvidia RTX Spark Explained: New AI PC Chip Takes on Apple and Intel
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nvidia**, a major semiconductor company, has launched the RTX Spark chip, a new superchip designed to power Windows PCs and challenge companies like **Apple** and **Intel**. The chip combines a 20-core CPU and a powerful GPU for AI performance.  It is expected to be used in laptops and desktops from brands like Dell, Asus, and HP, and will offer features like all-day battery life. This move comes as **Nvidia** has become the leading player in the AI hardware market due to its dominance in GPUs, while companies like **Intel** have struggled to adapt to changing trends.

top_stories.title: India Sits On 32,000 Tonnes of Gold. Why PM Modi Wants It Back In Play
top_stories.rephrased_article: **India** holds an estimated 30,000-35,000 tonnes of gold in households and temples, mostly unused. The **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has urged citizens to recycle this idle gold instead of importing it, citing the significant impact it could have on India's import bill.  Gold recycling involves refining old gold into pure 24-karat gold for use in jewelry and bullion markets. Experts estimate that even a small percentage of this unused gold could significantly reduce India's gold imports, improving external balances and strengthening macroeconomic stability.
